title: Expose the conducted-lesson attendance projection
verify: FT-007-AC-006: authorized student and Teacher attendance percentages use present conducted student/lesson slots over all conducted slots, including default-present, explicit absence, and correction cases.
No conducted slots returns 0%; the provider does not persist or mutate attendance or financial facts and denies unassigned/cross-center scope.
The projection is exposed through the accepted Learning Progress query and remains independent of Lesson Context presentation.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-006 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: the aggregate omits C&S-supplied conducted slots, mishandles default-present/absence/correction, accepts stale or unauthorized assignment scope, leaks another scope, or mutates facts; GREEN: isolated provider tests through the Actor Context and Calendar and Membership ports prove student/Teacher ratios, no-slot 0%, correction, removed-assignment/cross-center denial, no direct C&S-table read, and state-before/state-after equality; artifact: .tasks/TASK-089-T3-FT-007-W29/ and .protocols/TASK-089-T3-FT-007-W29/.
purpose: Own the Learning Progress attendance query consumed by the statistics projection.
success_outcome: Learning Progress returns authorized numeric attendance percentages over conducted lessons without changing attendance state.
anti_goals: Do not implement route tables or sorting.
Do not write attendance, charge, allocation, or balance state from the projection.
Do not inherit or re-prove Center & Scheduling facts or complete AC-003 composition.
constraints: Learning Progress owns attendance facts and the attendance aggregate; Lesson Context only consumes the resulting Personal Progress query.

Learning Progress obtains actor identity through Actor Context and lesson identity/status plus current class/assignment scope only through the Calendar and Membership Query Boundary; it does not read C&S tables.
The denominator includes every C&S-supplied conducted student/lesson slot and uses the accepted default-present workflow.
Tests use isolated disposable state and do not touch study-calendar.db.
invariants: A correction is reflected on read without projection writes.
Unassigned and cross-center requests are denied without unrelated data leakage.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-006: conducted/no-slot/default-present/absence/correction and student/Teacher scope matrix through the exact Actor Context and Calendar and Membership provider seams.

stop_conditions: Stop if the aggregate requires a new attendance source of truth or changes the accepted attendance transition.
Stop if the aggregate needs a new cross-slice edge, direct C&S persistence access, or caller-supplied assignment scope.
